issues.problem: Contexts 1 and 2 (mother: don't waste money; friend: don't tell anyone) gave no hint that the speaker expects bad behaviour, so the near-synonym 念を押す fitted the braces just as well.
issues.action: Added 今度は to context 1 (implies past waste) and 口の軽い to context 2 (friend known to gossip); updated the English to match.

issues.problem: Misuse 2 (paying one's own rent with 自腹を切って) is redundant and odd but not clearly wrong to a native speaker.
issues.action: Replaced it with a clearer misuse: using it for taking responsibility and resigning (a confusion with 腹を切る), with a new reason.

issues.problem: lit called a koku 'a short unit of time in the old clock'; in the traditional Japanese system one koku was about two hours (or about fifteen minutes in another system), so the claim is misleading.
issues.action: Rewrote lit to say that ikkoku, literally one koku of time, here means an instant.

issues.problem: Story checked: 縁起 as the Buddhist rendering of pratītyasamutpāda, then the founding history of temples and shrines, then an omen, is accurate.
